rationale: Price is at 97.4% of today's range, just $0.03 below the session high of $33.52, after a sharp intraday run from $32.35 — chasing a breakout this extended with 95 minutes to close and a negative earnings preview overhang creates unfavorable risk/reward in either direction. The last 5 candles show a spike to $33.52 on heavy volume (90k shares) but the prior candles were low-volume consolidation, suggesting the move may be exhausting rather than initiating. With the stock already up ~4.5% on the day and negative earnings sentiment, neither a long at the high nor a short against strong momentum offers a clean mechanical edge.
